tagline.en: Wan2.1-Fun 14B Control Camera — camera-controlled image-to-video from Alibaba PAI's VideoX-Fun.
tagline.zh: Wan2.1-Fun 14B Control Camera——出自阿里 PAI VideoX-Fun 的镜头可控图生视频。

en: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 14B Control Camera is a camera-controlled video model from Alibaba PAI's VideoX-Fun project, built on the Wan2.1 lineage. It generates video from an input image while letting you steer the virtual camera.

This is the dedicated 14B camera-control checkpoint: you give it a starting image and a camera trajectory, and it renders a clip that follows that viewpoint. It's the larger, higher-capacity option in the Wan2.1-Fun camera-control family.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline, providing the image and camera path; the checkpoint route is wired for camera-conditioned image-to-video.
zh: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 14B Control Camera 是阿里 PAI 的 VideoX-Fun 项目推出的镜头可控视频模型,构建在 Wan2.1 脉络之上。它从输入图片生成视频,同时让你操控虚拟相机。
这是专门的 14B 相机控制 checkpoint:你给它一张起始图片和一条相机轨迹,它便渲染出沿该视角运动的片段。它是 Wan2.1-Fun 相机控制家族中容量更大的选项。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行它,提供图片与相机路径;该 checkpoint 路径为镜头条件化的图生视频而接入。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want camera-driven image-to-video at higher capacity — deliberate dolly, orbit, or push-in shots from a starting frame, with the larger 14B model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要更大容量的、以相机为主导的图生视频时用它——从起始帧出发做刻意的推、拉、环绕镜头,并采用更大的 14B 模型。

notFor.en: Heavier than the smaller camera-control checkpoints, so it needs more compute. Requires the checkpoint to be downloaded before use.
notFor.zh: 比更小的相机控制 checkpoint 更重,需要更多算力。使用前需先下载 checkpoint。

en: From Alibaba PAI's VideoX-Fun, built on Wan2.1
Runs through the shared WorldFoundry pipeline
